technique_name: Explain what is meant by the 'bias-variance trade-off'.
description: The bias-variance trade-off is an important concept in machine learning which states that a model’s accuracy is determined by both the bias and the variance of the model. A model with high bias, or underfitting, will have low accuracy, while a model with high variance, or overfitting, will also have low accuracy.
